ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SCH_VIEW_INTERVAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*-- This procedure finds the interval for a procedure code --*/
procedure get_sch_view_interval (p_procedure_code in varchar2,interval out number) is
begin
 select nvl(sch_view_interval,0) into interval
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = p_procedure_code ;
 if interval = 0 then /*-- If proper interval not found, default to 30 --*/
 interval := 30 ;
 end if ;
exception
 when no_data_found then interval := -99 ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_RECORD_FROM_SCH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insert_record_from_sch IS
v_gmt_time date;
v_time_of_date date;
v_out_time_of_date date;
BEGIN
 
 v_time_of_date := to_date(to_char(:sch_block.sch_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')||' '||to_char(:sch_block.ctrl_sch_from_time,'HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI');
 

 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_time_of_date,v_gmt_time);
 
 v_out_time_of_date :=v_gmt_time;
 
 else
 
 v_out_time_of_date :=v_time_of_date;
 end if;
 
 Insert into fixed_site_slots (
 site_id,
 chapter_id,
 sch_date,
 proc_code,
 time_of_day,
 Max_slots,
 donation_type_group,
 booked_slots,
 program_id,
 insert_user,
 insert_date)
 values
 (:control_block.s_site_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :sch_block.sch_date, 
 :control_block.proc_code, 
 v_out_time_of_date, --;:sch_block.sch_from_time,
 1,
 :sch_block.donation_type,
 1,
 'MANUAL',
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 sysdate);
 
END;
